shortBio.en: Van Halen bassist; high harmony blend in the classic chorus stack.
shortBio.zh: Van Halen 贝斯手；经典副歌叠轨里的高声部和声融合。

body.en: Bass and background vocals through Roth and Hagar peaks. Later replaced on some lineups; harmony contribution is part of the classic mix identity.
body.zh: 贯穿 Roth 与 Hagar 巅峰的贝斯与和声。后来部分阵容被替换；和声贡献是经典混音身份的一部分。
